use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

const NS: &str = "urn:rust-proof:arithmetic";

fn number(coefficient: &str, scale: i32) -> Value {
    Value::Number {
        coefficient: coefficient.into(),
        scale,
    }
}

#[test]
fn matches_java_exactly() {
    let wide_sum = number(&format!("1{}1", "0".repeat(8191)), 4096);
    let wide_difference = number(&"9".repeat(8192), 4096);
    for (a, b, sum, difference, net, select_sum) in [
        (
            number("99999", 2),
            number("1", 2),
            number("100000", 2),
            number("99998", 2),
            number("2", 2),
            true,
        ),
        (
            number("-120", 2),
            number("3", 1),
            number("-90", 2),
            number("-150", 2),
            number("60", 2),
            true,
        ),
        (
            number("1", 0),
            number("-1000", 0),
            number("-999", 0),
            number("1001", 0),
            number("-2000", 0),
            false,
        ),
        (
            number("12", 1),
            number("-120", 2),
            number("0", 2),
            number("240", 2),
            number("-240", 2),
            false,
        ),
        (
            number("1", -4096),
            number("1", 4096),
            wide_sum,
            wide_difference,
            number("2", 4096),
            true,
        ),
        (
            number("1", -3),
            number("2", -2),
            number("12", -2),
            number("8", -2),
            number("4", -2),
            true,
        ),
        (
            number("0", 3),
            number("0", -2),
            number("0", 3),
            number("0", 3),
            number("0", 3),
            true,
        ),
        (
            Value::Null,
            number("12", 1),
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            false,
        ),
        (
            number("12", 1),
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            Value::Null,
            false,
        ),
    ] {
        let input = BTreeMap::from([((NS, "a"), a), ((NS, "b"), b)]);
        let selected = if select_sum {
            sum.clone()
        } else {
            difference.clone()
        };
        let expected = BTreeMap::from([
            ((NS, "sum"), sum),
            ((NS, "difference"), difference),
            ((NS, "net"), net),
            ((NS, "selected"), selected),
        ]);
        assert_eq!(evaluate(&input).unwrap(), expected);
    }
}
